description: This file defines the ReadWriteLock class, which implements a read-write lock mechanism with methods for acquiring and releasing read and write locks. It uses internal state management and synchronization primitives to coordinate access among multiple threads.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock
classes.description: A class providing synchronized read-write locking functionality, allowing multiple concurrent readers or exclusive writers.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a read lock, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: ReadUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired read lock.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a write lock, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: WriteUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired write lock.
